Title: (2196) - Data Scientist - Quality & Manufacturing
Description: ALTEN México busca un(a) Data Scientist – Quality & Manufacturing responsable de desarrollar e implementar soluciones avanzadas de analítica de datos, Machine Learning e Inteligencia Artificial para optimizar los procesos de calidad y manufactura. Esta posición transformará datos provenientes del piso de producción en modelos predictivos y herramientas digitales que permitan mejorar la calidad del producto, la eficiencia operativa y la toma de decisiones basada en datos. Responsabilidades Principales Diseñar, desarrollar e implementar modelos estadísticos, Machine Learning y Analítica Avanzada para mejorar indicadores de calidad y manufactura. Recopilar, procesar y analizar datos provenientes de líneas de producción, equipos, sistemas de calidad y operaciones de planta. Identificar tendencias, patrones y correlaciones para desarrollar modelos predictivos que permitan anticipar desviaciones de proceso y problemas de calidad. Colaborar con equipos de Calidad, Manufactura, Operaciones y Mantenimiento para desarrollar soluciones basadas en datos. Diseñar y mantener dashboards e indicadores utilizando Power BI, Tableau u otras herramientas de visualización. Desarrollar herramientas digitales y aplicaciones que mejoren la trazabilidad, precisión y accesibilidad de la información. Crear y mantener bases de datos, librerías de recurrencia y soluciones analíticas para la prevención de problemas de calidad. Implementar procesos de automatización utilizando Power Apps, Power Automate, SharePoint y herramientas similares. Asegurar la gestión integral del ciclo de vida de los modelos analíticos, incluyendo monitoreo, optimización y actualización continua. Participar en iniciativas de Industria 4.0, digitalización y transformación de procesos de manufactura. Brindar soporte técnico y mentoría a ingenieros y analistas en temas de ciencia de datos y buenas prácticas analíticas. Impulsar la toma de decisiones basada en datos para mejorar el desempeño operativo y los resultados del negocio. Entregables Clave Modelos predictivos y soluciones de Machine Learning implementados y validados. Dashboards e indicadores de Calidad y Manufactura desarrollados y actualizados. Bases de datos y librerías de información estructuradas y mantenidas. Soluciones de automatización implementadas para optimizar procesos operativos. Reportes de tendencias y análisis avanzados para soporte a la toma de decisiones. Integración y trazabilidad efectiva de datos provenientes de múltiples fuentes. Mejoras medibles en KPIs de calidad, productividad y desempeño operacional. Documentación técnica y metodológica actualizada. Requirements Requisitos mínimos que buscamos: Licenciatura en Ciencia de Datos, Ingeniería en Sistemas, Ingeniería Computacional, Ingeniería Industrial o carrera afín. Mínimo 5 años de experiencia en Ciencia de Datos, Machine Learning, Inteligencia Artificial o Analítica Avanzada dentro de entornos de manufactura. Experiencia en manufactura automotriz, vehículos pesados o industria manufacturera avanzada. Dominio avanzado de Python y/o R para análisis y modelado de datos. Experiencia avanzada en SQL para extracción y análisis de grandes volúmenes de información. Experiencia en desarrollo de dashboards utilizando Power BI, Tableau o herramientas similares. Conocimiento de estadística aplicada, análisis predictivo y visualización de datos. Experiencia con Power Apps, Power Automate, SharePoint y herramientas de automatización. Capacidad para trabajar directamente en planta y colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios. Inglés avanzado. Requisitos Deseados Experiencia en Industria 4.0 y Digital Manufacturing. Conocimiento de Deep Learning, IA Generativa y MLOps. Experiencia integrando información de MES, ERP, sistemas de calidad y equipos industriales. Experiencia con plataformas cloud y soluciones de analítica escalables. Conocimientos de RPA y automatización de procesos. Certificaciones en Data Science, Analytics, Power BI, Azure o tecnologías relacionadas. Experiencia liderando proyectos de transformación digital. Title: Practicante Analista de Innovación (Venture Clienting & Innovation Research)
Location: San Pedro Garza García, Nuevo León, Mexico
Description: Sobre VCL studio Las mejores ideas no siempre nacen dentro de una empresa. Por eso cada vez más corporativos apuestan por la innovación abierta y buscan innovar de la mano de startups, lo que se conoce como corporate venturing. Una de sus formas más ágiles es el Venture Clienting: en lugar de invertir en una startup, la empresa se vuelve su cliente y prueba su solución en un reto real. En VCL studio hacemos justo eso: conectamos a corporativos con las startups correctas y convertimos esos pilotos en resultados medibles de negocio. Somos un equipo pequeño y AI heavy users: usamos inteligencia artificial todos los días y buscamos constantemente optimizar nuestro trabajo e incrementar nuestra productividad con ella. El rol Como Practicante de Venture Clienting & Innovation Research serás parte activa de un equipo pequeño que trabaja con corporativos en México y LATAM. Tu trabajo combinará investigación y scouting de startups a nivel global con soporte operativo al equipo: desde la gestión del CRM y el seguimiento a leads hasta la preparación de materiales para clientes. Tendrás exposición directa al director general y responsabilidad real desde el primer mes. Aprenderás cómo operan los corporativos más relevantes de la región y conocerás de primera mano startups de alto impacto de todo el mundo. Qué vas a hacer Hacer investigación y scouting de startups a nivel global para retos concretos de clientes, y presentar los hallazgos de forma clara. Gestionar el CRM (HubSpot) y dar seguimiento a leads y al pipeline comercial. Investigar cuentas objetivo y armar listas de prospección. Preparar presentaciones y materiales para clientes corporativos. Apoyar el análisis de impacto de negocio de los proyectos que ejecutamos. Dar soporte operativo al equipo en el día a día (ClickUp, Drive y automatizaciones). Preparar research y primeros borradores de contenido de thought leadership. Usar y orquestar herramientas de IA en tu día a día para investigar, analizar y automatizar el trabajo. No vas a pasar el día armando bases o presentaciones a mano: para eso nos apoyamos en la IA. Tu valor está en entender, analizar y ayudar a tomar mejores decisiones. Lo que buscamos Estudiante de 6.° a 8.° semestre de Negocios, Innovación, Ingeniería o afines. Habilidades de investigación y análisis cualitativo y cuantitativo: evaluar soluciones de startups y tendencias de mercado, y estructurar la información en presentaciones claras. Buena comunicación para colaborar con el equipo, clientes y startups. Que ya uses IA en tu día a día para investigar, analizar, crear o automatizar. Interés genuino por la tecnología, las startups y la innovación, con ganas constantes de aprender. Proactividad y ownership: resuelves problemas sin esperar instrucciones paso a paso. Dominio del español e inglés. Dominio de Google Slides, Sheets y Docs. Deseable: ClickUp y HubSpot, o disposición para aprenderlos. Que te identifiques con nuestros cuatro pilares: proactividad, comunicación, persistencia y sentido humano. No esperamos que llegues sabiendo todo ni que ya conozcas Venture Clienting: tendrás capacitación y acompañamiento del equipo. Detalles Medio tiempo: 20–25 horas por semana. Presencial en San Pedro Garza García, N.L., con flexibilidad para trabajo híbrido. Nota: esta práctica es una etapa de inducción y aprendizaje. Buscamos a alguien con interés real en el Venture Clienting y la innovación corporativa, que la vea como el primer paso para incorporarse de tiempo completo al equipo al graduarse. Si quieres aprender donde la innovación se convierte en resultados, te queremos conocer. Where Venture Clienting gets done. Fecha de cierre: esta vacante estará abierta hasta el 5 de noviembre de 2026. Contactaremos a los candidatos seleccionados a más tardar durante la semana posterior al cierre.

Title: Inventory Management Leader
Description: Job Description Inventory Leader – Job Description Position Summary The Inventory Analyst supports Vertiv’s Materials and Inventory organization by providing hands-on analysis, reporting, and data governance that improves supply chain performance. The role focuses on the following core objectives: providing clear visibility into DIO drivers, managing MRP parameters related to inventory, improving our understanding of the connection between DIO performance and Promised Date Service Level (PDSL), and (3) strengthening Excess & Obsolete (E&O) reporting and alignment. The analyst partners with Regional Materials teams, Purchasing, Planning, and Finance to ensure accurate data, proactive shortage identification, and consistent, actionable reporting across sites. Key Responsibilities Reporting, Data Preparation & Insights Development Build new and repeatable inventory reports to create visibility into DIO drivers, fast‑turning materials, shortages and stockouts, backlog/work order alignment, and delivery frequency. Pull, clean, and analyze large datasets to ensure data is usable and accurate despite imperfections. Prepare concise summaries and dashboards for weekly and monthly inventory reviews. Conduct first-pass analysis to validate trends or discrepancies before escalating to leadership. DIO Support & Visibility into DIO Drivers Analyze what drives DIO up or down each period, including slow movers, PO/WO misalignment, supplier performance, and demand variability. Build datasets that allow leadership to understand key DIO drivers. Track recurring patterns influencing DIO and document findings for cross-functional follow-up. Provide insights that help plant teams understand the impact of planning and purchasing on DIO performance. MRP Parameter Governance & Optimization Review and analyze MRP planning parameters including safety stock, reorder points, fixed lead times, order modifiers, lot sizing, and sourcing attributes to identify opportunities for inventory optimization. Develop reporting that highlights parameter settings contributing to excess inventory, stockouts, shortages, or service level risk. Partner with Planning, Purchasing, and Materials teams to monitor parameter accuracy and recommend updates based on demand patterns, lead time performance, and inventory objectives. Support periodic parameter reviews to ensure planning settings remain aligned with current business conditions, supplier performance, and manufacturing requirements. Identify and escalate inconsistent or outdated MRP parameters across sites and drive standardization where appropriate. Analyze the impact of parameter changes on DIO, PDSL, inventory levels, and material availability, providing data-driven recommendations to leadership. Maintain governance processes and reporting to track parameter compliance, changes, and opportunities for continuous improvement. PDSL Improvement & Shortage Prevention Develop reporting that identifies materials at risk of missing promised delivery dates. Monitor fast‑turning materials to detect early signs of emerging shortages. Excess & Obsolete (E&O) Reporting & Management Prepare and refresh E&O reports, consolidating plant and Finance data. Track plant-provided reasons and actions for E&O and identify inconsistencies. Support root-cause investigation for recurring E&O drivers. Create simple trackers and visuals to support leadership reviews. Qualifications Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Analytics, Finance, Engineering, or related field. 5+ years of post-college experience in analytics, supply chain, operations, or materials. Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, data structuring). Ability to analyze large, imperfect datasets. Strong communication, organization, and follow‑through. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or Smartsheet. Exposure to manufacturing, materials planning, purchasing, or inventory management. Experience supporting inventory health metrics such as DIO or shortage analysis. Competencies Detail-oriented with strong data validation discipline. Analytical and curious—asks ‘why’ behind trends. Comfortable working through ambiguity and incomplete data. Strong follow-through and accountability. Ability to partner effectively with plant and cross-functional teams. Fast learner with system and process adaptability.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description: Job Title: Senior Data Analyst Location: Guadalajara, Hybrid This is a hybrid position, which will require the ability to be onsite in our Guadalajara, Mexico office as needed. Candidates must be based in Guadalajara. ABOUT THE COMPANY: Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we’re building the industry’s first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth. With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate. Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future. THE OPPORTUNITY: At Salesloft, our Senior Data Analysts turn data into the decisions that keep the company secure and running well. You will analyze security, operational, and business data to surface insight, quantify risk, and give the teams you support the evidence they need to act. Your analysis directly shapes how leaders understand and respond to what the data is telling them. This is a high-impact analytics role. You will build the reports, dashboards, and analyses that make complex security and operational data understandable and actionable, dig into questions that matter, and help the organization measure what's working. As AI reshapes both the threat landscape and how we work, your analysis helps the team see clearly and prioritize. On a day-to-day basis, you will: Analyze security, operational, and business data to surface insight, quantify risk, and answer the questions that matter. Build and maintain reports and dashboards that make complex data clear and actionable for technical and non-technical audiences. Partner with security, IT, and business stakeholders to define metrics and measure what's working. Investigate anomalies and trends in the data, translating findings into clear recommendations. Improve data quality and the analytical models behind the metrics you own. Communicate findings crisply, turning analysis into decisions leaders can act on. This role lives at the heart of how we practice Evidence Over Ego — you are, quite literally, the evidence function: you bring rigorous, honest analysis to decisions that would otherwise be made on instinct. And in the spirit of how we are Customer Inspired — where every decision has a true north, and it's our customer — the clarity you bring to security and operational data is part of how we protect the trust customers place in us. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR: We are looking for an experienced analyst who turns messy data into clear, trustworthy insight and communicates it in a way that drives action. You are rigorous with data and thoughtful about how you present it. You embody what we call Evidence Over Ego — bringing honest, data-grounded analysis is the entire job, and you are candid about what the data does and doesn't support. You are curious, rigorous, and motivated by helping teams make better decisions. This is the right role if you want your analysis to directly shape how a category-defining company operates and stays secure. THE TEAM: The Salesloft Security and data organization protects and governs the data the company and its customers depend on, and Senior Data Analysts turn that data into insight and decisions. The team works closely with Security, IT, and business stakeholders. The team Moves as One — analysts, security, IT, and business partners share ownership of data-driven decisions and coordinate directly. And we are relentlessly Customer Inspired: our customers' success is the only scorecard that matters, and clear, honest analysis of security and operational data is part of how we protect the company and its customers. Title: Master Data Engineer – Automation & Data Operations
Description: We’re Hiring: Master Data Engineer – Automation & Data Operations Location: Guadalajara, Mexico Role Level: Specialist About the Role Clean customer and order data is the critical dependency across our enterprise CRM and CPQ transformation roadmap. Today, too many rule-based decisions and data corrections are handled manually. This is a build role, not a queue-processing role. We are looking for a Master Data Engineer who designs, configures, and automates matching, merging, hierarchy resolution, and validation logic in Salesforce. In this position, data remediation is the method used to test, validate, and tune the automation logic—not a static backlog to absorb. Success is measured by driving manual touchpoints down and system throughput up. What You’ll Do Build Salesforce Automation: Design, build, and deploy matching, merging, deduplication, and validation rules in Salesforce (SFDC) to systematically eliminate manual touches and recurring defect patterns. Master Complex Hierarchies & Identifiers: Configure logic for parent–child, reseller, distributor, and end-customer relationships, as well as critical account-assignment checks (e.g., OPSI assignment rules). AI & Automated Matching: Implement automated and AI-assisted workflows for missing-data detection, account-matching assistance, and order classification. Validate on Production Populations: Run rule sets against live account and order records to evaluate precision and recall; baseline and prove performance metrics (match precision, manual touches per order, defect rate reductions) before release. Manage Residual Queues & Convert Patterns: Handle unautomated residual queues (e.g., complex indirect orders) while actively converting repeating defects into persistent validation rules to shrink operational queues over time. Technical Documentation & Governance: Author functionality specifications, data-model impact documentation, and acceptance test evidence inside Jira following agile delivery practices. Support Enterprise Initiatives: Partner with cross-functional teams (Product Owners, Solution Architects, SFDC Developers, Sales Ops, BI) supporting initiatives like enterprise territory alignments, Customer 360, and recurring billing enablement. What You Bring Experience: 5–8 years of hands-on experience in master data management (MDM), data operations, or CRM data quality within large-scale enterprise environments. Salesforce Build Capabilities: Deep technical configuration skills in Salesforce—Flows, duplicate/matching rules, validation rules, bulk data loading/operations, and reporting. Automation & Scripting: Proficiency in Python (or equivalent scripting language) with practical experience applying automation or ML logic to classification and matching problems. Data Remediation at Scale: Proven track record of cleaning and restructuring large volumes of customer, account, or order data, backed by measurable metric improvements. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Strong professional communication in English (written and verbal), comfortable working across global stakeholders across AMS, EMEA, and APJ. Bonus Points If You Have Prior experience with enterprise channel data structures and master identifiers (e.g., OPSI, BPID, HPD, OSS). Experience in Fortune 100 or global enterprise CRM/CPQ and order management ecosystems. Salesforce Certifications ( Administrator , Platform App Builder , or Data Architect ). Experience working in Jira and TestRail under structured sprint cycles. Interested in engineering out manual work and scaling enterprise data systems?

Title: Lead Product Data Analyst
Description: About LawnStarter LawnStarter is the nation's leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and outdoor services, with over $150M in annual bookings and two consecutive years of profitability. We're expanding beyond lawn care to become the one-stop shop for all home services, and we're investing in the next generation of our platform to get there. About The Team We're a high-leverage team of Product Data Analysts embedded across the business, owning the semantic layer and the metrics everyone trusts. We turn "I have a hunch" into "here's what actually happened," and we're the reason teams across the company can make calls on evidence instead of instinct. This role brings dedicated analytical firepower to the Pro (supply) side of that work. Requirements The Role As a Lead Product Data Analyst, you'll directly impact our results through insights and reports. You'll work closely with product managers, researchers, and other business stakeholders, helping with prioritization, assessments, and business recommendations. Alongside the rest of the Analytics team, it's your responsibility to nurture the data-driven culture within the company, making data easier to consume, whether through interactive reports, easy-to-use datasets, documentation, or training. You'll work with the autonomy of a Lead: setting your own standards, working independently, and acting as a trusted thought partner rather than an order-taker. That title isn't about managing people, there's no team attached to it. It's about the bar you hold your own analysis to, and the bar you help everyone around you reach. This role leans toward the Pro (supply) side of our marketplace, though the exact focus flexes with where the business needs the most insight. What You'll Own Modeling & Analysis: A marketplace is a complex system, with many moving parts and often contradicting signals. That creates an exciting pool of opportunities to find gaps, insights, and optimizations. Analyses range from a simple A/B test to a multivariate model on retention or ETA, backed by advanced SQL and intermediate Python or R Reporting: A complex system produces a high number of metrics worth tracking. A dashboard is only as good as our trust that it's correct and current. You'll understand the needs of the teams you work with and help create and maintain the reporting system, keeping it organized and easy to act on Analytics Engineering: Occasionally you'll work in the inner layers of the Data Warehouse to provide clean, documented datasets that power our reports and end users. We use dbt for transformation, so SQL is a must Problems to Solve Metrics nobody fully trusts. Different teams cite different numbers for the same thing, and no one's quite sure which is current. Untangling that and giving the business one number it can stand behind is core to the job. Analysis that ships but doesn't move anything. A technically correct answer that doesn't change a single decision is still a failure. Getting a stakeholder to actually act on what you found is the hard part, not the SQL. Data that's hard for anyone but an analyst to touch. If every question requires filing a ticket and waiting on you, you haven't built a data-driven culture, you've built a bottleneck. A system with too many moving parts and not enough signal. Supply, demand, pricing, and service quality all interact. Teasing out what's actually driving a metric versus what's noise is a real analytical problem, not a formality. What Success Looks Like (Year 1) The metrics teams rely on daily are trusted, documented, and current, no one's quietly keeping a shadow spreadsheet because they don't trust the dashboard Routine questions are self-serve: stakeholders find their own answers in existing reports instead of pinging you for a one-off pull You can name specific decisions your analysis changed, not just analyses you delivered The datasets and models you've built in dbt are clean and documented enough that other analysts build on them without redoing your work Who You Are AI-Native: You use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, and similar) daily to move faster: drafting and debugging SQL and dbt models, scripting analysis, and shaping reports, and you keep experimenting with new capabilities as they show up. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you're skeptical of AI tools or prefer to do everything by hand. Learning Mindset: You take pride in understanding problems deeply and asking the right questions before reaching for an answer. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you have a preconceived system of processes and methods and plan on just applying them without first learning all the ways our business is unique. Sets the Bar: As a Lead, you work autonomously, hold your own analysis to a high standard, and raise the bar for the people around you, whether or not they report to you. Product managers and stakeholders should see you as a trusted thought partner, not an order-taker. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you want a title and a team before you're willing to raise everyone else's standards. Team Player: You are ready to work alongside exceptional people, helping them achieve great results. You create an environment where people are excited to work with you daily, with intellectual honesty and trust. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you value being right over reaching the right answer together. Business Focus: You care deeply about understanding business needs and how your analysis connects with our product, customers, and financials. You can envision how metrics drill down from the highest to the lowest level, identifying what needs to be analyzed or reported on at each. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you're happiest doing analysis for its own sake, disconnected from a decision it will drive. Bias for Action: You understand that despite your careful approach to understanding problems, you actively avoid being a perfectionist or getting tied up in knots. You have a bias for action to make progress, and you enjoy being scrappy, with constraints that enthrall you. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you, by default, like building full solutions from the get-go. This Role Is NOT A ticket queue. You're not here to pull numbers on demand, you decide what's worth measuring and how to measure it A dashboard-admin seat. Maintaining BI tooling is part of the job, not the point of it. The point is the insight the dashboard delivers A people-management role. This is an individual-contributor seat. "Lead" describes the bar you hold yourself and others to, not a team you manage A role that waits for perfectly clean data. If you need data handed to you pre-cleaned before you can start, this isn't the right seat, you're expected to get your hands into the warehouse Tools of the Trade SQL and dbt for transformation and modeling, Python or R for the occasional statistical deep dive, and Lightdash as our primary BI layer for dashboards and self-serve reporting. Benefits Base salary: $75,000-$100,000 USD annually AI tooling provided: The Claude routines already running pieces of our experimentation process are yours to extend, not a side project you have to justify Fully remote: This is deep-focus analytical work with US-facing partners. We hire the best analyst regardless of city and trust you to manage your environment and overlap hours Flexible PTO: Measured on outcomes, not hours logged VERY IMPORTANT REMINDER: Please upload your English resume. Applications without it will not be considered.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex datasets and translate findings into actionable recommendations. Strong project and time management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple reporting requirements and meet deadlines. Title: Credit Risk Operations Analyst (CDMX)
Industries: Software Development, Financial Services, and Technology, Information and Internet
Description: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. About The Team At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together. We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity, and support where every team member's voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals. What you'll do The credit risk operations team plays a critical role in ensuring a healthy financial ecosystem for businesses around the world. This team will directly impact the company's bottom line and growth capabilities by supporting new and emerging businesses. The Credit Operations team is responsible for conducting credit risk assessments, underwriting small and mid-size users, and proposing mitigation strategies that enable Stripe to take smart risks for our users. Responsibilities Work with merchants, from successful venture-backed startups to well-established institutions, evaluating their business models and financial statements Help manage Stripe's portfolio by developing a deep understanding of risk across industries, geographies, and operating models Identify differing risks of complex business models and enforce appropriate loss mitigation actions based on your assessment Utilize analytics to optimize strategies that can be enforced across Stripe's portfolio Identify risk factors and trends and further report these identifiers to the wider risk team to ensure consistency in partnership Identify gaps in current systems, policies, and strategies, and recommend enhancements and process improvements Have an opportunity to learn how Stripe operates from the ground up and make a real impact on the future of the organization Be a part of building a brand-new team and operational culture for Stripe Partner with global operations specialists or business process owners to run a critical workflow Who you are We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum Requirements 1+ years of experience with knowledge of commercial credit underwriting, financial risk modeling, and cash flow forecasting Ability to transform business and financial data into a cohesive narrative that outlines potential credit risks Strong knowledge of accounting principles and comfort with evaluating financial statements and business models across a range of industries You excel in diagnostic thinking and problem-solving You have a process-oriented mindset and ability to get things done You enjoy working in an in-office environment with strong cross-team collaboration and support You are able to prioritize and enjoy working in a quick-moving environment You are humble and have a proven track record for working well across teams and with external partners You're willing to periodically work a weekend day for which you will receive a weekday off. The SDC operates during daytime hours with shifts from the morning through early evening Preferred Qualifications Proficiency in SQL or other data analysis tools The ability and desire to challenge the status quo In-office expectations Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible. Pay and benefits Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally. We look forward to hearing from you. At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us. Apply now

Title: User & Market Research Specialist (Fintech)(A218185)
Description: 职位描述： About the Role We are looking for a hands-on researcher to understand customer needs, financial behaviors, and product experiences, translating insights into actionable recommendations for Product, Risk, and Marketing teams. The role focuses on User Research and Brand & Market Research, supporting product optimization, responsible lending, and brand development in Mexico. Key Responsibilities 1. User Research & Product Insights Conduct customer interviews to understand financial needs, borrowing motivations, repayment behaviors, and credit experiences. Develop user profiles and behavioral segments based on financial habits, credit usage, and customer needs. Identify pain points across the lending journey, from application and approval to repayment and repeat borrowing. Conduct usability testing, feature testing, and concept validation to improve product experience. Collaborate with Product, Risk, and Data teams to translate customer insights into actionable product and credit strategy recommendations. 2. Brand & Market Research Conduct U&A studies and brand health tracking to understand consumer perceptions and brand performance. Evaluate campaign effectiveness, spokesperson fit, and creative concepts through consumer research. Monitor competitor activities, market trends, and social listening insights to provide actionable recommendations for brand and marketing strategies. 职位要求： Qualifications & Requirements 5+ years of experience in user research, consumer insights, UX research, or market research. Experience in financial services, banking, consumer lending, or fintech is required, preferably in digital lending or consumer credit. Strong experience in qualitative research, particularly researching credit users and financial inclusion; solid knowledge of quantitative research, including survey design, data analysis, and insight generation. Ability to independently manage research projects and deliver actionable recommendations to cross-functional teams. Strong understanding of credit user behavior and the local financial services market. Familiarity with credit risk, customer segmentation, and digital lending products. Fluent English and native-level Spanish, with strong ability to identify key insights and opportunities, and leverage AI tools to improve research efficiency and productivity. Bachelor's degree in Psychology, Sociology, Marketing, Business, Economics, or a related field.

Title: Senior Data Engineer
Description: Somos una empresa omnicanal impulsada por las personas y habilitada por la tecnología, dedicada a ayudar a las personas a ahorrar dinero y vivir mejor. En 2009, Walmart de México y Walmart Centroamérica iniciaron una nueva etapa de crecimiento al convertirse en un solo equipo. Desde 2010, operamos como Walmart de México y Centroamérica, una de las organizaciones de retail más importantes de la región. Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un(a) Senior Data Engineer con sólida experiencia técnica en sistemas distribuidos de gran escala, arquitectura de datos moderna y desarrollo de software. En esta posición, asumirás un rol técnico protagonista diseñando, construyendo y optimizando plataformas de datos a escala petabyte. Tu contribución permitirá habilitar soluciones analíticas avanzadas, integraciones con Inteligencia Artificial y flujos de negocio en tiempo real que mejoran la experiencia de millones de familias en toda la región. ¿Qué harás? Desarrollo Hands-On y Arquitectura: Diseñar, desarrollar y optimizar pipelines de datos distribuidos ( end-to-end ) para procesamiento masivo en batch y streaming , garantizando robustez, mantenibilidad y calidad de código de nivel de producción. Modernización de Plataformas: Colaborar en la definición técnica e implementación de arquitecturas analíticas modernas ( Data Lakehouse, Data Mesh, Lambda/Kappa ). Liderazgo Técnico y Mentoría: Guiar técnicamente a ingenieros de datos en el diseño de soluciones, realización de revisiones de código ( code reviews ) y adopción de mejores prácticas de ingeniería de software. Gobierno y Observabilidad: Implementar marcos automatizados de calidad de datos, monitoreo de salud de pipelines, linaje y catalogación, asegurando el cumplimiento de normativas de seguridad, confidencialidad y privacidad. Colaboración Interdisciplinaria: Interactuar directamente con Product Managers, Data Scientists y líderes técnicos globales de Walmart Inc. para traducir requerimientos de negocio en arquitecturas de datos escalables. Requisitos ¿Qué buscamos? Experiencia profesional: Al menos 5 años de trayectoria demostrable en ingeniería de datos o ingeniería de software enfocada en datos masivos. Cómputo distribuido y Big Data: Sólido dominio en computación distribuida y procesamiento de datos a gran escala utilizando Apache Spark , ecosistemas Hadoop/Hive y SQL avanzado de alto rendimiento. Desarrollo de software: Experiencia sólida escribiendo código limpio, modular y probado en producción utilizando Python, Java o Scala . Arquitectura de eventos y streaming: Diseño e integración de pipelines de datos en tiempo real mediante Apache Kafka o plataformas equivalentes. Ecosistema Cloud & CI/CD: Experiencia en desarrollo sobre plataformas en la nube ( Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure o AWS ) e implementación de pipelines de despliegue continuo (CI/CD) para soluciones de datos. Modelado y desarrollo en plataformas analíticas modernas como Databricks, dbt o Snowflake .
